how_to_find: Open your fork of the business-onboarding-intake repository on GitHub. Read the date of the newest commit that came from the product (keyona-rerev/business-onboarding-intake). The product has no known tags or releases (VERIFY).

versions.title: Paste-and-extract returns as a dashboard window
versions.summary: Newest product commit at wizard release: 56cdefe on 2026-07-09. This entry comes from commit dates and messages. VERIFY the grouping into versions with ReRev Labs.

changes.text: The paste-and-extract intake opens as a window on the dashboard (commit c780b12).
A bad push that replaced home.html with a placeholder is fixed. The full page is back (commit 56cdefe).

upgrade_steps.title: Sync your fork and redeploy
upgrade_steps.text: On GitHub, open your fork and select Sync fork. Netlify then builds a new deploy by itself. No database change is needed.

versions.title: First build and day-one changes
versions.summary: The repository was created on 2026-07-07. The commits of that day add the four brand colors, three source address fields, a cached dashboard, logo upload and plain-language help boxes. This entry comes from commit dates and messages. VERIFY.

changes.text: Four named brand color fields: background, accent, highlight and sparing accent.
Three separate source address fields, checked as real web addresses.
Cache-first dashboard, so the page loads fast after login.
Plain-language help box in every section.
Option lists for formats, time zones and posting cadence. Editing moves into the dashboard.

upgrade_steps.title: Sync your fork and redeploy
upgrade_steps.text: On GitHub, open your fork and select Sync fork. Netlify builds a new deploy by itself.

upgrade_steps.title: Database columns update by themselves
upgrade_steps.text: The server functions add the new columns the next time a business logs in. The old color columns and the old source column are removed at that time. No manual SQL is needed. New businesses get the new columns from schema.sql.
